'''Maree Praji''' was the wife of [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] and the mother of [[Onnelly Praji]]. After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she and her daughter moved from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].
